title: The Adventure of the Three Garridebs

topics.title: The narrator, the date and John Garrideb's arrival

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the narrator and explain how the opening frames the story and fixes its date.
Explain how Holmes reads the visitor's English outfit and Watson's directory search.

topics.title: John Garrideb's tale of the strange will

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the terms of Alexander Hamilton Garrideb's will as told by John Garrideb.
Analyse how Holmes tests and exposes the falsehoods in the visitor's story.

topics.title: Nathan Garrideb's museum and the Birmingham advertisement

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Nathan Garrideb's appearance, collection and dreams.
Interpret the American clues in the Howard Garrideb advertisement and the plan behind it.

topics.title: Holmes identifies Killer Evans and the Presbury link

concepts.learning_objective: Recall what Holmes learns about Killer Evans from the Scotland Yard records.
Explain how Holmes connects Rodger Presbury with Nathan Garrideb's room.

topics.title: The trap, the wound and the resolution

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the climax in the room and the secret hidden beneath the floor.
Evaluate what Watson's wound reveals about the friendship between Holmes and Watson.
Interpret the irony and subtle humour in the story's ending.
Infer the meaning of difficult words and phrases from their context in the story.
Explain the figurative meaning of idiomatic expressions used in the story.
